_about: Demo-day overrides for config.py (CONJ-19). Edit numbers here after the freeze, never code. Keys starting with _ are notes. Values below are the current defaults until rehearsal tunes them.
_stage: Click mode Conjure starts in on stage, over the saved profile. Decide at rehearsal: pinch, dwell, or custom.
_tracking: Raise these if a busy background or a second person causes phantom hands; lower if tracking drops in dim light.
_pinch: False clicks while moving: lower PINCH_ENGAGE_RATIO or raise PINCH_OPEN_EXTENSION / PINCH_HOLD_MS. Missed pinches: the reverse.
_spell: Spell misses at the venue: raise GESTURE_MATCH_SCALE (1.2 = 20% more forgiving). Spell fires on its own: lower it.
_pause: Pauses during normal use (flaky tracking): raise PAUSE_AFTER_FRAMES.
_voice: Seconds to wait for ElevenLabs before the offline voice speaks. Keep at or under 1.0.
